hub.speaker: iona
hub.text: You want something, or are you checking I'm still upright?

choices.text: You wanted to talk. About Jessa Orrin?
Why ship's security? You could have been anywhere.
choices.show_locked: Iona doesn't trust you with that yet (influence 65+)

choices.text: You've seen me use Resonance. Do you feel anything, when I do?
You've seen what I can do. Ever wonder about it?

hold_high.speaker: iona
hold_high.text: Better than I should be. Working with you helps. Don't let it go to your head.

orrin.speaker: iona
orrin.text: Jessa Orrin. Crewman, second class. She was in Corridor C-3 when the pickets came online. I was thirty metres away with a sidearm and a door I couldn't open.

choices.text: You couldn't have saved her from behind a sealed door.
We can mourn her once we're off this ship.

orrin_about.speaker: iona
orrin_about.text: She played the worst Shards on the ship and bet like she was winning. She wanted to fly. She was going to put in for the Tessaly academy this rotation.

orrin2.speaker: iona
orrin2.text: I'm not asking you to fix it. I needed somebody besides the manifest to know her name. Thanks for listening.

ward_good.speaker: iona
ward_good.text: I keep replaying the moment the seal opened. Thank you. You let me be the one to undo it.

ward_rush.speaker: iona
ward_rush.text: We got them out. It cost someone in triage. I'd make the same choice. I hate that I'd make the same choice.

ward_bad.speaker: iona
ward_bad.text: Don't. I know why you did it. I did it first. I don't need to talk about it to keep carrying it.

past.speaker: iona
past.text: Tessaly security service, ten years. A governor ordered us to clear a strike line with stun batons. I refused. They didn't fire me; they transferred me to a refugee ship and called it mercy. When Varr told me to seal Ward 2, I thought: last time I refused, someone else just did it worse. So I did it myself. That's the story.

choices.text: Refusing that order was right. Sealing the ward wasn't. You know the difference better than anyone.
You did what kept the most people alive. That's the job.

past2.speaker: iona
past2.text: Here's something I haven't told you. Varr's launch codes are split authority: command plus the senior security officer. That's me. If she won't release the Petrel, I can. And here: something they teach security on Tessaly. Fire so they keep their heads down; don't fire to kill. Covering fire. It'll keep you alive.

effects.reason: Iona trusts you with her story

res_seen.speaker: iona
res_seen.text: Wonder? It scares me a little. It also... when you opened that door, I felt it. Like a pressure behind my eyes. I've never told anyone I feel things like that.

train.speaker: iona
train.text: Every time. Like hearing music through a wall. Are you saying I could learn it?

choices.text: Lattice screening missed people all the time. Close your eyes. Find the pressure. Breathe into it.
Not now. It's dangerous to learn in a crisis.

train_ok.speaker: narrator
train_ok.text: You talk her through the first exercise the Lattice ever taught you: find the hum, don't fight it, follow it. Iona's breath catches. A faint warmth gathers around her hands, and the cut on her knuckle closes as you watch.

train2.speaker: iona
train2.text: ...That was me. That was actually me. I'm going to need a minute. And then I'm going to need you to teach me everything.

low.speaker: iona
low.text: We need to talk. I don't trust your judgment. I've watched you make calls I'd file a report on. Give me a reason to keep following you.

choices.text: You're right to push back. I've made calls I'm not proud of. Keep pushing.
Because I'm the one getting people off this ship.
Follow me or don't. Your choice.

low_ok.speaker: iona
low_ok.text: ...All right. I'll keep pushing. You keep listening.

low_fail.speaker: iona
low_fail.text: Then I'll stay as far as the bay, because the passengers need me. After that, we're done.
